PT- Nossa equipe está completa, e no momento, estamos focados no desenvolvimento do nosso projeto, compartilhando ideias e unindo nossas habilidades para criar uma solução inovadora para um desafio do mundo real. 
EN- Our team  is already complete, and we are currently focused on developing our project, sharing ideias, and combining our skills to create an innovative solution to a real-world challenge.
details:
Our project is an Interactive Learning Environment that teaches children and curious learners about the equipment left on the Moon and Mars during space missions.

Through an interactive story, players become the main character, explore different environments, and discover what these objects are, why they were sent, and their contributions to science.

The experience uses storytelling, voice narration, challenges, and rewards to make learning fun and engaging. It also considers accessibility for people with visual and hearing impairments and compatibility with TVs, tablets, and smartphones.

Our goal is to make space education more accessible, inclusive, and interactive, encouraging curiosity through technology, creativity, and exploration.
